events.title: Phase 1: Tools Registry, a team key and skill vault
events.detail: Kickoff 2026-06-30. A remote registry that turns a team's skills into callable tools via a credential-injecting proxy; consumer is the team's own agents. Public repo 2026-07-15, PyPI/npm 0.1.0 2026-07-16.

events.title: Phase 3: routed capabilities, cache and overflow (treg chooses)
events.detail: treg moves from 'you pick the provider' to first-party routed endpoints (treg.<capability>) with fallback and waterfall, plus an answer archive/cache (08-27) and aggregator overflow (08-28). Arenas (09-08, 10-02), AIGC models (09-01), hub (09-09, off by default).

events.title: superdesigndev/superdesign repo created (IDE design agent)
events.detail: Open-source design agent extension for Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code; 7,545 stars and 774 forks at 2026-10-28.

events.title: superdesign.dev: 'Open Source Design Agent' inside your IDE
events.detail: Wayback title 'Superdesign.dev - Open Source Design Agent'; description: generate UI, mockups and wireframes inside your IDE.

events.title: loopany repo: self-iterating agent memory, from crewlet.io
events.detail: README: 'a side project from crewlet.io, the self-improving company: a single AI agent that runs the company autonomously'.

events.title: CLI split from server: light pip install, [server] extra (v0.2.0)
events.detail: Packaging split so the CLI installs without FastAPI/DB deps; npm launcher @superdesign/treg 0.1.0 published same day; CI and LICENSE added for going public.

events.title: Jason Zhou: founder/CEO
events.detail: 1562 commits all branches (1284 on main), first 2026-07-16, last 2026-10-25. Top areas by files touched: catalog 2636, backend 1739, product/docs 889, tests 716. Email domains: gmail.com, superdesign.dev.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.1.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: README: 'Stop pasting API keys into agent contexts and Slack DMs'
events.detail: Vault-era pain-led tagline; 'Treg (Tool-Registry)'.

events.title: OAuth provider registry: connect Google, Slack, X without own app
events.detail: Curated OAuth providers; connections yield working calls. Week 30 adds LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, Google Ads dev token held by treg.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.5.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: Endpoint catalog: 2,617 operations across 46 providers
events.detail: YAML catalog of upstream endpoints (core hand-curated + extended machine-generated) introduced with docs/context/architecture/catalog.md.

events.title: Local proxy (treg shell --proxy, treg serve)
events.detail: Intercepts agent's own calls to allow-listed hosts; server injects credentials.

events.title: Platform keys + prepaid balance: ledger and metered marketplace calls
events.detail: Keyless catalog calls metered against an org wallet on treg's own provider keys (tier 4); ledger.py and billing introduced; money is integer micro-USD.

events.title: Landing v3: 'turn your coding agent into an SEO expert, a media buyer, an SDR'
events.detail: Replaces the vault-story landing with a role proposition; struck seat prices; 2,617 endpoints across 42 providers.

events.title: Charter records shift: 'the catalog became the front door'
events.detail: From 'share what we already have' to 'get what you don't have'. Retired words: vault, marketplace, registry. Charter deliberately not rewritten: 'rewriting the past would be dishonest'. Production still had TREG_PLATFORM_PROVIDERS empty that day.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.7.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: First "$0.000 markup" public claim; X-Treg-Cost-Micro header
events.detail: Landing copy "provider rate + $0.000 markup = your price" appears; /call/ starts reporting what each call cost.

events.title: Agent-facing copy: 'reach for treg FIRST for external/live data'
events.detail: An agent picked a competitor MCP because its description led with a hard trigger; treg reframed mcp.py, skill.md, llms.txt and plugin.json. README H1 becomes 'Treg (OpenRouter for Tools)'.

events.title: X OAuth calls metered: treg's X app pays X per use
events.detail: X moved to prepaid pay-per-use billed to the app owner, so calls on a registry X connect spend treg's credits; they now go through the tier-4 reserve/settle path (ledger tier: oauth). Kill switch default off.

events.title: Inflection: catalog-first + treg.to cutover lifts installs ~20x
events.detail: PyPI downloads went from a 10-20/day baseline (Jul 28-Aug 9) to 510 on Aug 12 and 341 on Aug 13 (release days 0.9.0-0.11.0); forks 25 that week vs 1-2/week before. Stars 158 on Aug 12.

events.title: Releases 0.10.0 (treg.to default) and 0.11.0 (MCP call parity)
Shared-plan convention shipped with Alpha Vantage pilot rate
events.detail: treg_shared_plan marker, validator and recovery report; pilot $0.001/call vs $49.99/mo fee, break-even 50,000 calls/mo. Pilot prices nothing (treg holds no Alpha Vantage subscription).

events.title: Market data category: CoinGecko and Marketstack subscriptions bought
events.detail: CoinGecko Basic $29/mo (100k credits) and Marketstack Basic $9.99/mo (10k req) held for platform serving; others own-key only for licence reasons.

events.title: "0% markup" stated on landing and in structured data
events.detail: Schema description "$1.00 of free credit on every new team, then pay per call at the provider's own rate, treg adds 0% on top".

events.title: Dual-sided referral: $5 friend / $10 referrer, later $5/$5
events.detail: 'Flat bounties, not a percentage: platform_margin is 0.0 and "we add no markup" is a public promise'. Changed to both sides $5 on 08-18.

events.title: Release 0.12.0: search-friendly catalog names
Layered architecture: role-aware app factory and import-linter boundaries
events.detail: bootstrap.create_app(role) with all/dataplane/control route manifests and import-linter contracts (routers->application->domain->infra).

events.title: Bonus tiers 5/7.5/10% tried and reverted within minutes
events.detail: Commit f844b00e set 5/7.5/10%; reverted by 69a5bfbb 83 seconds later back to 0/5/10/15%.

events.title: Archive/cache subsystem PR 1: tables and skeleton
events.detail: Versioned history of answers with a cache layer on top; six PRs; R2 body storage added 2026-09-10.

events.title: Routed endpoints: treg.people.email.find picks cheapest child, waterfall
events.detail: First place treg models upstreams and chooses a provider on opt-in: contracts.yaml + adapters, error fallback, opt-in waterfall; phone/verify/enrich routes followed same day.

events.title: Overflow relays via aggregator accounts (off by default)
events.detail: 461 candidate pairs, 145 verified, 113 enabled; same endpoint via Orthogonal/Monid when treg's own account is out.

events.title: Release 0.13.0 (repo only; not on PyPI) and 0.14.0 (08-30)
Launch landing pages /people-search and /grokbot; /fable (09-02)
events.detail: Model-launch and vertical pages.

events.title: AI coding model in use: Claude Fable 5.1
events.detail: First commit trailer naming Claude Fable 5.1. Model mix: Jul Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, Aug Opus 5 (1M), Sep Fable 5.1, Oct Opus 5.5.

events.title: Error billing: per_call 4xx bills only what the vendor reports
events.detail: Fiber 400/404 had settled twenty $0.04 holds; rejected requests now release as rejected_unbilled unless the body carries a vendor charge.

events.title: Enrich Arena: paid provider comparisons
events.detail: Arena runs the same enrichment question across providers; insights aggregated by a cron worker.

events.title: Tool hub phases 1-4 incl. QuickJS script sandbox (behind flag)
events.detail: Makers publish tools composed of tools; scripts run in a separate process with QuickJS, no network, rlimits; security pass 2026-09-10.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.17.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.19.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: reAPI and PiAPI listed beside OpenRouter for Seedance 2.5
events.detail: Two resellers on the same join key; reAPI $0.1186/s at 480p, PiAPI $0.15/s, OpenRouter $0.1028/s.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.19.1 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: No platform daily cap: the team sets its own (default none)
events.detail: "The platform-wide $500 ceiling fired only on funded teams mid-workload and never on abuse."

events.title: Release 0.20.0
YouTube attribution: hashed-email conversions, consent mode
events.detail: YouTube ad test instrumentation.

events.title: Discovery experiment: LLM relevance judge behind MCP catalog search
events.detail: TypeSafe System One (Jev) judge over widened lexical recall; shadow/interleave modes; SearchLog table.

events.title: Landing title: 'treg.to: OpenRouter for agent tools and data, pay per call'
events.detail: Replaces the role title; description 'One MCP server, one key... at the provider's own rate, no markup.' Counts generated (3,600+ across 91), not typed.

events.title: Hub listing requires treg approval; updates to listed tools reviewed
events.detail: Search placement gated by superadmin approval; price changes on listed tools wait for review.

events.title: New dashboard served to all visitors at full rollout
PyPI tools-registry 0.22.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: Web Arena: gated provider comparison for web search
events.detail: Migration 0057 web_arena.

events.title: PyPI tools-registry 0.23.0 released
events.detail: CLI release on PyPI.

events.title: Archive opt-out with erasure for teams
Inflection: open-source toolkit cadence (Oct 8 to Oct 26)
events.detail: Five X launch videos in 19 days. Successful calls/day 1.6M (Oct 6) -> 2.2M (Oct 7) -> 3.8M (Oct 13) -> 5.0M (Oct 20) -> 6.3M (Oct 27). Stars 4,286 (Oct 6) -> 6,425 (Oct 28).

events.title: SSO priced in code at WorkOS pass-through ($125/$250), markup 0
events.detail: PLANS = {"sso": 125, "sso_directory": 250} + enterprise_sso_markup_usd (default 0).

events.title: Release 0.26.0
Call events: pseudonymous per-call events to Iceberg via Cloudflare Pipelines
events.detail: HMAC-pseudonymized events to an R2 Data Catalog Iceberg table, outside Postgres, for provider benchmarks.

events.title: Capital Brief: no funding disclosed; Airtree partner only in photo
events.detail: Photo caption shows Zhou with Airtree partner Jackie Vullinghs; article does not say Airtree invested.

events.title: Public /rankings page built by a worker from endpoint day stats
events.detail: Most used, most reliable, fastest, head-to-head boards; migration 0087.
